teacher_dashboard.header: Stats summary (active exams, total students, flagged anti-cheat incidents)
teacher_dashboard.exam_list: Table / Grid of created exams with join codes, status (Brouillon, En cours, Terminé), allowed tools badges, direct link to live monitoring and copy code button.
teacher_dashboard.quick_actions: Button 'Créer un nouvel examen', 'Rejoindre une session d'observation'

exam_builder.steps: 1. Informations de base (Titre, Matière, Consignes, Durée) -> 2. Type d'examen (Formulaire, Rédaction / Composition, Document PDF/Word téléversé) -> 3. Autorisations des outils & Sécurité (WordQ, Antidote, Lexibar, Usito.usherbrooke.ca, WordReference, Blocage du presse-papier, Plein écran obligatoire, Seuil max d'avertissements) -> 4. Aperçu & Publication
exam_types: Formulaire Interactif (QCM, Réponses courtes, Questions développées)
Rédaction / Composition Libre (Éditeur de texte enrichi sécurisé)
Document PDF/Word Téléversé (Visualiseur de document + zone de réponse)

tool_toggles.label: Antidote (Correcteur)
tool_toggles.desc: Permettre le lancement de l'application Antidote locale

tool_toggles.label: Dictionnaire Usito (usito.usherbrooke.ca)
tool_toggles.desc: Ouvrir Usito dans un panneau sécurisé intégré

tool_toggles.label: WordReference
tool_toggles.desc: Ouvrir WordReference dans un iframe/modal contrôlé

student_portal.join_screen: Card to enter 6-digit Code d'examen, Nom complet, Code permanent / Matricule. System check (Fullscreen readiness, Clipboard lockdown check).
student_portal.pre_exam_modal: Liste des règles: Interdiction de changer d'onglet, Alt+Tab bloqué, Clic droit désactivé, Presse-papier verrouillé. Outils autorisés listés clairement.

student_locked_exam_environment.header: Persistent bar showing: Timer décomptant, Indicateur d'enregistrement automatique ('Sauvegardé à 14:32'), Code élève, Boutons d'outils autorisés (Usito, WordReference, Antidote, WordQ, Lexibar) et Bouton 'Remettre l'examen'.
student_locked_exam_environment.anti_cheat_engine: Detection of visibilitychange, blur, contextmenu, copy, paste, cut, key combinations (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Alt+Tab, F12). Log exact violation with timestamp to backend and show non-blocking toast warning.
student_locked_exam_environment.max_violations_trigger: If violations reach max (e.g., 3 warnings), show locked screen modal overlay requiring teacher passcode or auto-submitting.
student_locked_exam_environment.tool_sidepanel: Slide-out drawer or tab modal containing embedded authorized web tool windows (Usito / WordReference) with strict URL sandboxing.

realtime_monitoring_and_grading.live_monitoring: Realtime student status list (En train de composer, Onglet quitté, Avertissement émis, Terminé/Remis). Live filter by alert level.
realtime_monitoring_and_grading.student_detail_drawer: Show exact chronological timeline of events (e.g. 10:14:02 - Changement de fenêtre détecté).
realtime_monitoring_and_grading.grading_page: Manual & automated scoring, custom feedback comments per question, PDF & Word report export generation.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, tab items, tool buttons, submit triggers, modal buttons) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Strict WCAG AA adherence. Interactive elements must maintain explicit readable hover text colors. Never use transparent header backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app is in French (Québec academic context: 'Évaluation sécurisée', 'Antidote', 'WordQ', 'Lexibar', 'Usito').
Use React standard .js files with Tailwind CSS and pre-built Shadcn components located in src/components/ui/.
Implement mock anti-cheat listeners (fullscreen exit detector, focus blur counter, right click prevent, copy/paste prevent) for immediate realistic feedback during student test taking.

Include sample default exams (e.g., 'Examen de Français - Synthèse de texte', 'Évaluation de Mathématiques SN4', 'Rédaction d'histoire') pre-populated so the user can test student and teacher experience right away.
Always include data-testid on buttons, inputs, modals, and list items for automated testing.
